title: How PID control can revolutionize benchtop thermal testing
summary: Introducing the RapidTemp™ BT28 ThermoStream®, featuring advanced DUT (Device Under Test) control powered by PID technology.
body_markdown:
Introducing the RapidTemp™ BT28 ThermoStream®, featuring advanced DUT (Device Under Test) control powered by PID technology.


Unlike traditional systems that only regulate the air or enclosure temperature, our cutting-edge DUT control precisely manages the temperature of the device itself, ensuring faster, more accurate testing results.


Elevate your testing capabilities with the precision and efficiency of the RapidTemp™ BT28 ThermoStream®.


Learn more about the[RapidTemp™ BT28 ThermoStream®](https://www.intestthermal.com/benchtop-thermal-test-system) .
